Jordan / team —

Thanks for flagging. Quick guidance:

1) Vesting cliff: Redwood policy is a 1-year cliff for full ASU grants for ICs at hire to align with our standard grants and SEC/409A timing. We can’t broadly move to a 6-month cliff, but we do have two flexible levers:
   - Offer a one-time accelerated tranche: we can make 12.5% of the grant subject to a 6-month vest (i.e., an early-release tranche) while keeping the 4-year schedule and 1-year cliff on the remaining grant. This is an atypical but legally clean approach.
   - Alternatively, increase the cash sign-on by ~$8k to bridge the candidate if the early vest is a blocker.

2) Start date: Jan 19 is acceptable. It does not impact comp nor sign-on; we’ll adjust the start date field in the offer and the DocuSign packet. No policy issues.

Suggested redline language (for the offer PDF):
"Equity: The award vests over four years with a 12-month cliff. In addition, 12.5% of the total award will vest after six months of continuous service (an accelerated tranche). The remainder vests thereafter on the standard schedule"

If everyone is good with the accelerated tranche, I’ll update the offer PDF and re-generate the DocuSign envelope. If we prefer cash, let me know and I’ll update the sign-on field.

Mina
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
